config_notes: OpenAI and Anthropic retries set to 0 (default 2).
Timeout set to 3 seconds; programmatic setup without Spring Boot auto-configuration.
Anthropic base URL uses the cell root.
Anthropic max_tokens is explicitly 1024, sufficient for the replayed control call.
Model-stream attaches toolCallbacks by mutating the model options, preserving their provider-specific type and configured defaults; OpenAI 2.0.2 requires OpenAiChatOptions on Prompt.
DeepSeek uses deepSeekApi(), options() and retryTemplate(new RetryTemplate(RetryPolicy.withMaxRetries(0))); released RetryUtils configures maxRetries(10).

DeepSeek completionsPath is /v1/chat/completions (default /chat/completions). Reactor Netty response/connect timeouts are 3 seconds; automatic transport retries are disabled. Blocking calls use ReactorClientHttpRequestFactory with the same timeout.

control_failures.notes: Synthetic fixture with null assistant content, which the DeepSeek API reference documents as allowed (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion/). Whether the live API sends null or an empty string is unverified until a live response is recorded. PR #6775 references the related streaming issue https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/issues/5568; that issue is not evidence of this blocking-path fix.
